units.text: Chapter 2. CIVIL SERVICE POSITIONS

units.locator: Article 8. Civil service positions
units.text: Article 8. Civil service positions
units.label: Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Civil service positions
units.text: Positions in the federal state civil service are established by federal law or a decree of the President of the Russian Federation; positions in the state civil service of constituent entities of the Russian Federation are established by laws or other normative legal acts of those constituent entities, taking account of this Federal Law, to support the exercise of the powers of a state body or a person holding a state office.
units.label: Art. 8 · text

units.locator: Article 9. Classification of civil service positions
units.text: Article 9. Classification of civil service positions
units.label: Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Classification of civil service positions
units.text: 1. Civil service positions are divided into categories and groups.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Classification of civil service positions
units.text: 2. Civil service positions are divided into the following categories:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Classification of civil service positions
units.text: 1) managers: positions of heads and deputy heads of state bodies and their structural subdivisions (hereinafter also subdivisions), heads and deputy heads of territorial bodies of federal executive bodies and their structural subdivisions, and heads and deputy heads of representative offices of state bodies and their structural subdivisions, held for a fixed term of office or without a limitation on the term of office;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Classification of civil service positions
units.text: 2) assistants (advisers): positions established to assist persons holding state offices, heads of state bodies, heads of territorial bodies of federal executive bodies and heads of representative offices of state bodies in exercising their powers, and held for a fixed period limited by the term of office of those persons or heads;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Classification of civil service positions
units.text: 3) specialists: positions established to provide professional support for the performance of the assigned tasks and functions of state bodies and held without a limitation on the term of office;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Classification of civil service positions
units.text: 4) support specialists: positions established to provide organizational, information, documentation, financial and economic, administrative and other support for the activities of state bodies and held without a limitation on the term of office.
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Classification of civil service positions
units.text: 3. Civil service positions are divided into the following groups:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Classification of civil service positions
units.text: 1) highest civil service positions;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Classification of civil service positions
units.text: 2) principal civil service positions;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Classification of civil service positions
units.text: 3) leading civil service positions;
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Classification of civil service positions
units.text: 4) senior civil service positions;
units.label: Point 4 Part 3 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Classification of civil service positions
units.text: 5) junior civil service positions.
units.label: Point 5 Part 3 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Classification of civil service positions
units.text: 4. Positions in the categories ‘managers’ and ‘assistants (advisers)’ are divided into the highest, principal and leading groups of civil service positions.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Classification of civil service positions
units.text: 5. Positions in the category ‘specialists’ are divided into the highest, principal, leading and senior groups of civil service positions.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Classification of civil service positions
units.text: 6. Positions in the category ‘support specialists’ are divided into the principal, leading, senior and junior groups of civil service positions.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 10. Registers of state civil service positions of the Russian Federation
units.text: Article 10. Registers of state civil service positions of the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Registers of state civil service positions of the Russian Federation
units.text: 1. Federal state civil service positions, classified by state body, category, group and other criteria, form lists of federal state civil service positions constituting the corresponding sections of the Register of Federal State Civil Service Positions. The Register of Federal State Civil Service Positions is approved by a decree of the President of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Registers of state civil service positions of the Russian Federation
units.text: 2. State civil service positions of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation in its state bodies, established with regard to the structure of those bodies and classified by categories and groups of positions in accordance with Article 9 of this Federal Law, form lists of state civil service positions of that constituent entity constituting the corresponding sections of its register of state civil service positions. The register of state civil service positions of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation is compiled with regard to the principles used to structure the Register of Federal State Civil Service Positions and approved by a law or other normative legal act of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Registers of state civil service positions of the Russian Federation
units.text: 3. Repealed. — Federal Law No. 419-ФЗ of 28.12.2010.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks
units.text: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks
units.label: Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks
units.text: 1. A federal civil servant is awarded a class rank of the state civil service of the Russian Federation (hereinafter a civil service class rank of the Russian Federation), a justice class rank or a diplomatic rank. A civil servant of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation is awarded a civil service class rank of that constituent entity.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks
units.text: 2. Civil service class ranks of the Russian Federation are awarded to federal civil servants holding civil service positions for which the award of justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks is not provided.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks
units.text: 3. Justice class ranks are awarded to federal civil servants holding civil service positions for which legal education is a qualification requirement, in federal state bodies designated by the President of the Russian Federation and their territorial bodies (bodies), and in the staff offices of federal courts.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks
units.text: 4. Diplomatic ranks are awarded to federal civil servants in accordance with Federal Law No. 205-ФЗ of 27 July 2010 ‘On Specific Features of Federal State Civil Service in the System of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation’.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks
units.text: 5. Class ranks — civil service class ranks of the Russian Federation, civil service class ranks of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and justice class ranks — are awarded to civil servants individually, in sequence, in accordance with the civil service position held and with regard to their professional level and length of civil service in the preceding class rank and in the civil service position held.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks
units.text: 6. Federal civil servants holding positions in the highest group (except those awarded diplomatic ranks) are awarded the civil service class rank of the Russian Federation of Active State Councillor of the Russian Federation, class 1, 2 or 3, or the justice class rank of Active State Councillor of Justice of the Russian Federation, class 1, 2 or 3. Civil servants holding positions in the highest group of the civil service of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation are awarded the civil service class rank of that constituent entity of Active State Councillor of the Constituent Entity of the Russian Federation, class 1, 2 or 3.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks
units.text: 7. Federal civil servants holding positions in the principal group (except those awarded diplomatic ranks) are awarded the civil service class rank of the Russian Federation of State Councillor of the Russian Federation, class 1, 2 or 3, or the justice class rank of State Councillor of Justice of the Russian Federation, class 1, 2 or 3. Civil servants holding positions in the principal group of the civil service of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation are awarded the civil service class rank of that constituent entity of State Councillor of the Constituent Entity of the Russian Federation, class 1, 2 or 3.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks
units.text: 8. Federal civil servants holding positions in the leading group (except those awarded diplomatic ranks) are awarded the civil service class rank of the Russian Federation of Councillor of the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation, class 1, 2 or 3, or the justice class rank of Councillor of Justice, class 1, 2 or 3. Civil servants holding positions in the leading group of the civil service of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation are awarded the civil service class rank of that constituent entity of Councillor of the State Civil Service of the Constituent Entity of the Russian Federation, class 1, 2 or 3.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks
units.text: 9. Federal civil servants holding positions in the senior group (except those awarded diplomatic ranks) are awarded the civil service class rank of the Russian Federation of Referent of the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation, class 1, 2 or 3, or the justice class rank of Lawyer, class 1, 2 or 3. Civil servants holding positions in the senior group of the civil service of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation are awarded the civil service class rank of that constituent entity of Referent of the State Civil Service of the Constituent Entity of the Russian Federation, class 1, 2 or 3.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks
units.text: 10. Federal civil servants holding positions in the junior group are awarded the civil service class rank of the Russian Federation of Secretary of the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation, class 1, 2 or 3. Civil servants holding positions in the junior group of the civil service of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation are awarded the civil service class rank of that constituent entity of Secretary of the State Civil Service of the Constituent Entity of the Russian Federation, class 1, 2 or 3.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks
units.text: 11. The civil service class ranks of the Russian Federation of Active State Councillor of the Russian Federation, class 1, Active State Councillor of the Russian Federation, class 2, and Active State Councillor of the Russian Federation, class 3, and the justice class ranks of Active State Councillor of Justice of the Russian Federation, class 1, Active State Councillor of Justice of the Russian Federation, class 2, and Active State Councillor of Justice of the Russian Federation, class 3, are awarded by the President of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks
units.text: 12. In federal executive bodies, the civil service class ranks of the Russian Federation of State Councillor of the Russian Federation, class 1, State Councillor of the Russian Federation, class 2, and State Councillor of the Russian Federation, class 3, are awarded by the Government of the Russian Federation. In other federal state bodies and public authorities of a federal territory, those class ranks are awarded by the head of the respective body.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks
units.text: 13. The civil service class ranks provided for by parts 8–10 of this Article are awarded by the employer's representative.
units.label: Part 13 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks
units.text: 14. Repealed. — Federal Law No. 645-ФЗ of 29.12.2022.
units.label: Part 14 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks
units.text: 15. As an incentive for exceptional distinction in the civil service, a civil service class rank of the Russian Federation or a justice class rank may be awarded to a federal civil servant:
units.label: Part 15 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks
units.text: 1) before expiry of the period established by a decree of the President of the Russian Federation for service in the relevant class rank, but no earlier than six months after taking up the civil service position held, at a rank no higher than that corresponding to that civil service position;
units.label: Point 1 Part 15 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks
units.text: 2) after expiry of the period established by a decree of the President of the Russian Federation for service in the relevant class rank, at one step above the class rank corresponding to the civil service position held, within the group of positions to which that position belongs.
units.label: Point 2 Part 15 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks
units.text: 16. The procedure for awarding and retaining civil service class ranks of the Russian Federation for federal civil servants, the correlation between civil service class ranks of the Russian Federation, military and special ranks, justice class ranks and prosecutorial class ranks, and the correspondence between civil service class ranks of the Russian Federation and federal civil service positions in the highest group are established by a decree of the President of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 16 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks
units.text: 17. The correspondence between civil service class ranks of the Russian Federation and federal civil service positions in the principal, leading, senior and junior groups in federal executive bodies is established by a resolution of the Government of the Russian Federation. In other federal state bodies and public authorities of a federal territory, that correspondence is established by legal acts of those bodies.
units.label: Part 17 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks
units.text: 18. The procedure for awarding and retaining justice class ranks for federal civil servants, and the correspondence between justice class ranks and federal civil service positions, are established by a decree of the President of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 18 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Civil service class ranks, justice class ranks and diplomatic ranks
units.text: 19. The procedure for awarding and retaining civil service class ranks of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, and their correspondence to civil service positions of that constituent entity, are established by a law of the constituent entity, taking account of the provisions of this Article.
units.label: Part 19 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 12. Qualification requirements for civil service positions
units.text: Article 12. Qualification requirements for civil service positions
units.label: Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Qualification requirements for civil service positions
units.text: 1. Holding a civil service position requires compliance with qualification requirements concerning the level of professional education, length of civil service or work in a specialty or field of training, and professional level, and, where the employer's representative has made a corresponding decision, the specialty or field of training (broader groups of specialties and fields of training) and the qualification obtained by completing an additional professional retraining programme.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Qualification requirements for civil service positions
units.text: 2. Qualification requirements for civil service positions are established in accordance with the categories and groups of civil service positions and the field and type of a civil servant's professional service activity.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Qualification requirements for civil service positions
units.text: 3. Holding positions in the ‘managers’, ‘assistants (advisers)’ and ‘specialists’ categories of the highest and principal groups of civil service positions requires higher education at no less than specialist degree or master's degree level.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Qualification requirements for civil service positions
units.text: 4. Higher education is mandatory for positions in the ‘managers’ and ‘assistants (advisers)’ categories of the leading group, the ‘specialists’ category of the leading and senior groups, and the ‘support specialists’ category of the principal and leading groups of civil service positions.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Qualification requirements for civil service positions
units.text: 5. Professional education is mandatory for positions in the ‘support specialists’ category of the senior and junior groups of civil service positions.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Qualification requirements for civil service positions
units.text: 6. Qualification requirements for the length of civil service or work in a specialty or field of training necessary to hold federal civil service positions are established by a decree of the President of the Russian Federation; those for civil service positions of constituent entities of the Russian Federation are established by laws of the constituent entities.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Qualification requirements for civil service positions
units.text: 7. Qualification requirements concerning professional level are established by a civil servant's official duties regulations according to the category and group of the civil service position and the field and type of professional service activity. A civil servant's official duties regulations (hereinafter official duties regulations) may also prescribe qualification requirements concerning the specialty or field of training (broader groups of specialties and fields of training) and the qualification obtained through an additional professional retraining programme necessary to hold the civil service position.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Qualification requirements for civil service positions
units.text: 8. To provide methodological assistance to state bodies, the federal state body responsible for managing state service compiles a reference guide to qualification requirements concerning specialties, fields of training (broader groups of specialties and fields of training) and professional level necessary to hold civil service positions, with regard to the field and type of civil servants' professional service activity.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Qualification requirements for civil service positions
units.text: 9. Unless otherwise established by this Federal Law, compliance of a citizen seeking a civil service position or a civil servant with the qualification requirements for that position is checked by the state body's subdivision responsible for state service and personnel (hereinafter also the state body's personnel service).
units.label: Part 9 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Qualification requirements for civil service positions
units.text: 10. To check whether a citizen seeking a civil service position or a civil servant meets the qualification requirements concerning professional level, the state body's personnel service assesses that citizen's or civil servant's professional level for the position. The assessment uses methods not contrary to federal laws or other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation, with the participation of the state body's subdivision in which the position is established. By decision of the head of the state body or a person authorized by that head, scientific, educational and other organizations specializing in the relevant fields and types of civil servants' professional service activity or in personnel technologies and civil service matters, and their representatives, may be involved in the assessment.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 12

units.locator: Chapter 3. LEGAL POSITION (STATUS) OF A CIVIL SERVANT
units.text: Chapter 3. LEGAL POSITION (STATUS) OF A CIVIL SERVANT
units.label: Chapter 3. LEGAL POSITION (STATUS) OF A CIVIL SERVANT

units.locator: Article 13. Civil servant
units.text: Article 13. Civil servant
units.label: Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Civil servant
units.text: A civil servant is a citizen of the Russian Federation who has undertaken obligations to perform civil service. A civil servant carries out professional service activity in a civil service position in accordance with an act of appointment and a service contract, and receives monetary remuneration funded by the federal budget, the budget of the Sirius federal territory taking account of Article 47 of Federal Law No. 437-ФЗ of 22 December 2020 ‘On the Sirius Federal Territory’, or the budget of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Art. 13 · text

units.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.label: Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 1. A civil servant has the right to:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 1) provision of proper organizational and technical conditions necessary for performing official duties;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 2) access to the official duties regulations and other documents defining their rights and duties in the civil service position held, criteria for evaluating the efficiency of performance of official duties, indicators of the effectiveness of professional service activity and conditions for career advancement;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 3) rest, secured through normal working hours, days off and nonworking public holidays, and annual paid basic and additional leave;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 14
